cases.name: calendar-year-2026-with-payroll
cases.description: The 2026 compliance clock for a calendar-year Delaware C corporation with payroll: Form 941 for 2025 Q4 due 2026-01-31, the Delaware annual report and franchise tax due 2026-03-01, Form 1120 for 2025 due 2026-04-15, then the 2026 Q1-Q3 Form 941 dates (2026-04-30, 2026-07-31, 2026-10-31), in due-date order. Dates are nominal: entries whose nominal date lands on a weekend (2026-01-31 Saturday, 2026-03-01 Sunday, 2026-10-31 Saturday) carry needsReview true for the rule's next-business-day treatment.
cases.source: The dated rule cards named by each entry's ruleId in open-law/ (IRS Instructions for Form 941 due-date table; IRS Instructions for Form 1120; 8 Del. C. § 502)
